newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-WARM WEATHER PREVENTS WOMEN'S TRAINING.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WARM WEATHER PREVENTS WOMEN'S TRAINING.

text.p: High temperatures and soft snow conditions forced the cancellation of training on Wednesday for a women's World Cup downhill ski race.

Five hundred volunteers had worked since dawn on the Mount Lachaux course but with temperatures climbing towards 10 degrees Celsius officials were forced to postpone training for Friday's downhill, the third speed event of the women's season.
Race officials said they might try to hold two practice runs on Thursday.
